stem.en: Suppose all the ribosomes were removed from the rough endoplasmic reticulum of a cell. Which job of that part of the ER would stop first?

text.en: Making all the DNA of the cell, because the ribosomes on the ER hold it.

feedback.en: Ribosomes do not make or hold DNA. They are the sites of protein synthesis.

text.en: Storing water and cell sap, because that is the main work of the ER.

feedback.en: Water and cell sap are stored in vacuoles, not in the ER.

text.en: Controlling which substances pass into the cell across its plasma membrane.

feedback.en: That is the work of the selectively permeable membrane, not of ribosomes.

explanation.en: Ribosomes are the sites of protein synthesis. Without them, this part of the ER would look like smooth ER, and it would no longer make proteins on its surface.
